target: IGS221/IG221.ACC serial / intended US TOS 1.04 software graphics
provenance: Handwritten literal signed-word lengths, coordinates, raw payloads and independent FNV fingerprints over explicit big-endian rectangles and length+payload bytes. Full scene checks reuse pinned US TOS glyph/index/palette expectations, never emulator-generated images. Original DATA loopback word is0; both zone tables are in zero-initialized BSS.
